off_menu.scope_note: The menu-bounded champion is on-menu by construction (off-menu rate 0 always), so this instrument is VACUOUS for the champion and meaningful only for free-policy-family recordings (Tasks 18.22/18.24). FSM-generated bytes are the all-on-menu fixture (rate 0). It is the emergence gauge for behaviour classes unreachable by the FSM menu and a Tier-B pre-registration input (18.4 quotes the impostor_decisions denominator + the off-menu counters pinned here). It is NOT the training harness anchor cross-entropy (rollout-time, distributional) — do not conflate the two.
